source_authority: data/model-economy/ord-223-report.md §G (Order 2 design, ORD-223); slice S3 of ORD-224; authority pattern per data/me-s3-profiles/design-ruling.md.
description: Canonical, machine-authoritative source of truth for the 11 governed agent profiles (model-economy program). Validated against docs/model-economy/schemas/governed-profiles-manifest.schema.json. Every other surface is a derived projection asserted equal to this manifest: the IN-SESSION .claude/agents/<profile>.md frontmatter (whole-object projection equality) and, when it carries governed entries, the SHELL-CREW state/crew-profile-bindings.json. Never hand-maintain a second surface; edit this manifest and run bin/fm-profile-matrix-check.sh. Each profile carries the concrete committed maxTurns used in the frontmatter plus maxTurns_bounds as calibration-pending bounds (§G / B.1 #5) the concrete value is checked against.

haiku-evidence.description: Governed profile — objective, verifiable evidence-gathering. Haiku, no effort field, read-only, no nesting.

haiku-log-compressor.description: Governed profile — faithful log/output compression. Haiku, no effort field, read-only, no nesting.

sonnet-high-engineer.description: Governed profile — focused bounded implementation with tests. Sonnet, fixed high effort, no nesting.

sonnet-high-reviewer.description: Governed profile — routine diff/test review and evidence synthesis. Sonnet, fixed high effort, read-only, no nesting.

opus-low.description: Governed profile — lower-difficulty bounded reasoning meeting the Opus model gate. Opus, fixed low effort, read-only, no nesting.

opus-medium.description: Governed profile — medium-difficulty bounded engineering/decision work. Opus, fixed medium effort, no nesting.

opus-high.description: Governed profile — DEFAULT for complex bounded engineering/decision work. Opus, fixed high effort, no nesting.

opus-xhigh.description: Governed profile — EXCEPTION ONLY, requires recorded justification. Opus, fixed xhigh effort, no nesting.

fable-low.description: Governed profile — EXCEPTIONAL lower-difficulty orchestration Opus could not bound. Fable, fixed low effort, restricted nesting.

fable-medium.description: Governed profile — EXCEPTIONAL medium-difficulty orchestration/reasoning meeting the Opus-insufficiency gate. Fable, fixed medium effort, restricted nesting.

fable-high.description: Governed profile — EXCEPTIONAL highest-difficulty bounded orchestration. Fable, fixed high effort (absolute ceiling), restricted nesting.
